items.name: Engsmelle
items.observations: Illustration shows the principal field-recognition characters of Silene vulgaris: inflated ovoid or bladder-like calyces with reddish, netted longitudinal venation; white petals divided into paired lobes; exserted stamens; loose, branching cymes; opposite narrow grey-green lanceolate leaves; and a mostly glabrous upright stem with basal shoots. Juvenile buds, open flowers and mature inflated calyces are illustrated together.
items.limitations: Stylized watercolor rendering shows additional swollen calyces, enlarged floral details, and artistically reconstructed basal roots and leaf arrangement. Petal lobing varies between individual drawn flowers. The image is a visual field-guide aid, not definitive species-level evidence; licensed species photograph remains available for checking actual specimens and distinguishing similar Silene species.
